column1: # Connected MAX/MIN aggregate runtime source evidence.

column5: One nullable state selected by AggregateKind now owns fallible MAX/MIN update, strict comparison, partial merge, reset, and NULL final-result behavior for the current signed, unsigned, real, decimal, string, and byte Datum domains and is consumed by Database and window aggregate folding. String comparison uses the payload's canonical collation and rejects mismatches; mixed domains, range sentinels, and unordered reals fail instead of behaving as ties. Float32 narrowing, descriptor-driven typed coercion and collation selection, temporal, duration, JSON, vector, enum, set, live sliding callbacks, memory accounting, and spill encoding remain open. MinMaxDeque remains an isolated helper rather than a live window consumer.
